description: The context usage popup marks cache misses above their calls. The screen is 1280x800, and models cost (per million tokens) $5 input, $25 output, $0.50 cache read and $6.25 cache write. The conversation has three calls: the first writes 10000 tokens to the cache, the second reads them back, and the third finds only 500 still cached. "The graph" is ".chat-context-popup .token-cost-graph"; "the svg" is its ".token-cost-graph-svg"; "the mark" is the svg's ".token-cost-miss-mark"; "the readout" is the graph's ".token-cost-readout-live"; "box" means getBoundingClientRect(). Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and click ".context-usage-label". 2. The svg should be visible (allow 30s). 3. There should be exactly 1 mark, and its d attribute must contain exactly one "M". The readout should contain "▼ marks a cache miss.". 4. The mark's box bottom (y + height) must be <= (the box y of the first ".token-cost-axis" in the svg's g[data-pane="incremental"]) + 0.5. 5. "The bars": for every match of /M([\d.]+),[\d.]+V[\d.]+H([\d.]+)/g in the d attributes of the svg's g[data-pane="incremental"] path[fill] elements, the pair [left, right] of its two numbers. Their distinct left values, sorted ascending, must be exactly 3; "bar k" is the bar whose left is the k-th of them. "markMid" is the number right after the leading "M" of the mark's d, plus 3: it must be > bar 3's left and < bar 3's right. 6. "Hover at X" means: hover the svg at x offset X / W * (the svg's box width), where W is the third number of the svg's viewBox attribute, and y offset half the svg's box height (offsets from its top-left corner). 7. Hover at markMid: the readout's ".token-cost-hover-text" should match /^call 3,/, and the readout's ".token-cost-call-why" should match /^▼ Cache miss(, [\dhms ]+ after the previous call)?: 500 of 11k prompt tokens were still cached\.$/. 8. Hover at the middle of bar 2 ((left + right) / 2): the hover text should match /^call 2,/, and there should be no ".token-cost-call-why" in the readout (count 0).

'ok' : 'fail'; })()

(() => { const svg = document.querySelector('.chat-context-popup .token-cost-graph-svg'); const paths = svg.querySelectorAll('g[data-pane="incremental"] path[fill]'); const bars = []; const re = /M([\d.]+),[\d.]+V[\d.]+H([\d.]+)/g; for (const p of paths) { const d = p.getAttribute('d'); let m; re.lastIndex=0; while ((m=re.exec(d))!==null) bars.push([parseFloat(m[1]),parseFloat(m[2])]); } const dl = [...new Set(bars.map(b=>b[0]))].sort((a,b)=>a-b); return dl.length; })()

(() => { const svg = document.querySelector('.chat-context-popup .token-cost-graph-svg'); const mark = svg.querySelector('.token-cost-miss-mark'); const d = mark.getAttribute('d'); const mm = d.match(/^M([\d.]+)/); const markMidX = parseFloat(mm[1]) + 3; const paths = svg.querySelectorAll('g[data-pane="incremental"] path[fill]'); const bars = []; const re = /M([\d.]+),[\d.]+V[\d.]+H([\d.]+)/g; for (const p of paths) { const pd = p.getAttribute('d'); let m; re.lastIndex=0; while ((m=re.exec(pd))!==null) bars.push([parseFloat(m[1]),parseFloat(m[2])]); } const dl = [...new Set(bars.map(b=>b[0]))].sort((a,b)=>a-b); const b3l=dl[2]; const b3r=bars.find(b=>b[0]===b3l)[1]; return (markMidX>b3l && markMidX<b3r)?'ok':'fail'; })()

(() => { const svg = document.querySelector('.chat-context-popup .token-cost-graph-svg'); const svgBox = svg.getBoundingClientRect(); const W = parseFloat(svg.getAttribute('viewBox').split(' ')[2]); const mark = svg.querySelector('.token-cost-miss-mark'); const d = mark.getAttribute('d'); const mm = d.match(/^M([\d.]+)/); const markMidX = parseFloat(mm[1]) + 3; return Math.round(markMidX / W * svgBox.width); })()
